description: Read a statement off the ledger, or integrate the balances checkpoint. statement picks it; write_csvs also writes the full CSV suite to S3 and returns per-statement links.

statement.description: trial_balance: every account's debits/credits over range. income: revenue/expenses/net income over range (start and end required). balance_sheet: assets/liabilities/equity as of a date. balances: integrate ledger activity into the balances checkpoint (closes the period; fires the CSV suite itself).

range.description: trial_balance, income, balances: the time window. Both bounds optional except income, which requires start and end.

dimensions.description: trial_balance, income, balance_sheet: optional slice filter — only entries stamped with ALL these key/values count (e.g. {"location": "2"}). Unstamped entries belong to no slice.

asOf.description: balance_sheet only: ISO 8601 cutoff, defaults to now.

periodStart.description: balance_sheet only: period start for current-period retained earnings.

accounts.description: balances only: account-name filter, empty = all.

standard.description: balances only: close revenue/expense to retained earnings (defaults on).

write_csvs.description: trial_balance, income, balance_sheet: also write the five-statement CSV suite to S3 and return the links. balances writes it on its own.

periodEnd.description: with write_csvs: the suite's end-of-period date; defaults to range.end / asOf / now.
